Install React, React DOM and motion in your consuming project. The preview uses motion 14.6.0; original code imports framer-motion.

Copy Example.tsx into a client component and render its App export. Review fixed sizing, keyboard controls and reduced motion before production use.

Original source is unchanged under upstream/. Example.tsx only adds the Next client boundary and current motion/react import. The separate MigBits preview adds pause/reduced-motion handling; that wrapper is not silently claimed to be part of the upstream source.

No Motion+ components, website screenshots, photos or paid examples are included. The source is a technical example, not a complete application.
